question: Who among the following proposed the term ‘Ecosystem’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AG Tansely.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An early proponent of the field of ecology is the** English botanist AG Tansely.**
 
• In biology, he introduced the idea of an** ecosystem.**
 
• **Tansley **was** knighted in 1950 **and elected a **Member of the Royal Society** in **1915.**
 
• **Regular Tansley Reviews **are published by** The New Phytologist**, and the **New Phytologist Trust **bestows the** Tansley Award** in his honor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lindeman **:**

 
 
• **Ecologist Raymond Laurel Lindeman** was a pioneer.
 
• His graduation work on the subject of** trophic dynamics** is regarded as a **foundational study** in the field of ecosystem ecology.
 
 
 
• **Turreson:**
 
 
• Turreson was a pioneer in** ecological genetics** and an **evolutionary botanist** from Sweden.
